# What an extrapolation given nothing fixes

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Given nothing, a prefix fixes the whole future through the map in every world a list holds; what a learnable feature adds to it is exactly a reading of that future, so no extrapolation given nothing learns every learnable feature.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Unrolled on its own proposals, an extrapolation that proposes the course's value at every step from some step on proposes the course at every step ahead; in every world a list holds, from the identification bound on, the extrapolation by elimination over the lasso candidates, given nothing, so proposes the value through the map at every step ahead, along orbits and along runs. (`Becoming.Learning.extendBy`, `Becoming.Learning.extendBy_of`, `Becoming.Learning.unroll`, `Becoming.Learning.ahead`, `Becoming.Learning.unroll_prefix`, `Becoming.Learning.ahead_accords`, `Becoming.Learnable.ahead_fixes`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.ahead_fixes`)
2. A feature read off the future through the map is learned by the extrapolation given that reading, from the identification bound on, and from some step on where it is such a reading from some step on. (`Becoming.Learnable.ReadOff`, `Becoming.Learnable.reading`, `Becoming.Learnable.reading_predicts`, `Becoming.Learnable.reading_predicts_from`)
3. In a world a list holds, a feature is learnable through the map exactly where some reading of futures, respecting values at each step, is the feature from some step on along every orbit (and along every run); returning configurations whose features agree from some step on have equal features. (`Becoming.Learnable.eq_of_returns`, `Becoming.Learnable.readAt`, `Becoming.Learnable.fromWorld`, `Becoming.Learnable.fromWorld_respects`, `Becoming.Learnable.reads_of_agree`, `Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff_reading`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.future_eq`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.learnable_iff_reading`)
4. Given nothing, no extrapolation rests in accord with every learnable feature: in a one-configuration world the features true and false are each learned given their reading, with the same prefixes. (`Becoming.Learnable.given_nothing_not_every`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.given_nothing_not_every`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A list holding the orbit (or the world); values through the map compared decidably; a reading respecting values at each step (no function extensionality is assumed); for the exact theorem a fallback value of the feature, read nowhere along an orbit.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- An extrapolation that finds the reading: the reading of the first direction of the exact theorem is given the world, the law and the feature (fromWorld).
- Undetermined processes; rates beyond the stated bound (learning from finitely many labelled values of the feature is in what-finitely-many-labels-fix).
- **Counterexample:** One configuration, one value through the map: the features true and false are each learnable, and no single extrapolation rests in accord with both (given_nothing_not_every). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unrolling.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
